classification.basis: The plan defines B0 as kernel rejection or no useful kernel output. The custom-kernel invocation produced zero stdout and stderr, never dispatched the Toybox smoke test, produced no dmesg, Windows event, or crash artifact, and was killed after the strict 45-second timeout. This proves no checkpoint above B0; it does not distinguish image rejection from failure during unobserved early kernel startup.

firstObservableFailure: wsl.exe did not dispatch the Toybox command before the 45-second timeout
interpretation: The unchanged mkroot kernel is a valid generic Linux lower bound because it passed G4 under QEMU, but it lacks the Hyper-V guest core present in every captured WSL-oriented config. The evidence points first to the Hyper-V execution bundle, not storage, host sockets, networking, or the WSL init syscall substrate.
